response.overlap_recovery_reason: The three spectra remain visually separable across the main plot; only brief colored crossovers are present and no hidden continuation warrants a separate recovery pass.

curves.overlap_notes: Solid black spectrum crosses the blue dashed trace near x~435 and the red dash-dot trace near x~455, but stays visually separable.
Blue dashed spectrum crosses the black solid trace near x~435 and the red dash-dot trace near x~485; dash gaps were kept conservative by sampling only visible stroke columns.
Red dash-dot spectrum crosses the black solid trace near x~455 and the blue dashed trace near x~485; points were kept on visible dash/dot segments rather than interpolated through blank gaps.

response.interpretation_notes: Single UV-Vis panel with three pH-dependent spectra. The main plot contains one solid black, one dashed blue, and one dash-dot red curve; the in-panel legend was ignored for tracing. QA passed all three curves, with only mild pairwise review flags where the low-intensity tails converge near the baseline.
unresolved_ambiguities: The blue and red tails run within a few pixels of each other near the baseline from approximately x=960 to x=1088, which triggered a pairwise review warning despite both individual traces passing QA.

Short pairwise review ranges also appear for black-vs-blue around x=744-775 and black-vs-red around x=911-950 because the curves flatten toward the baseline, but the sampled points remain on their labeled strokes.

advisories.note: For marker-bearing curves, strong near-border fractions can indicate marker-rim or frame-lock tracing even when color overlap is high. Hollow-marker centerline traces use relaxed stroke-overlap thresholds only when marker-center alignment is also good.

panel_acceptance.pass: all curves pass and no pairwise review flags
panel_acceptance.warn: no curve fails, but at least one curve warns or at least one pair is overlap-flagged
panel_acceptance.fail: at least one curve fails stroke agreement or extent coverage

panels.overlap_recovery_reason: The three spectra remain visually separable across the main plot; only brief colored crossovers are present and no hidden continuation warrants a separate recovery pass.
